dataset.name: Pretreatment metastatic melanoma (Riaz, 2017)
dataset.description: Independent advanced-melanoma cohort with pretreatment bulk RNA-seq and overall survival after nivolumab therapy.
dataset.cohort_context: Treatment-selected advanced melanoma treated with nivolumab. Only source-labelled pretreatment tumor biopsies are retained; on-treatment biopsies are excluded.

metadata.curation_note: The frozen DataHub profile contains 107 RNA-seq biopsies from 64 patients. All 56 source-labelled on-treatment biopsies are excluded, leaving one pretreatment profile for each of 51 endpoint-complete patients.
metadata.source_crosscheck: The underlying RNA-seq study is publicly deposited as GEO GSE91061; the DataHub release supplies the harmonized expression and treatment-anchored clinical tables used by this repository release.

expression.label: iAtlas log TPM (provided scale)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated rows with the same supplied symbol are averaged sample-wise; different identifiers are never merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The DataHub molecular-profile metadata describes these values as RNA-seq log TPM. TRACE Explorer preserves the supplied values and does not apply a second logarithm.
